remarks: Located in Norwalk's "best-kept secret," this renovated mid-century modern home is set within the sought-after coastal community of Village Creek. Residents enjoy a private beach, tennis court, dog park, and marina.   The south-facing living room features vaulted ceilings and expansive picture windows that fill the open floor plan with natural light. The eat-in kitchen is both functional and inviting, with stainless steel appliances, a gas range, granite countertops, and views overlooking the fireplace-perfect for everyday living and entertaining.   The fully finished walk-out lower level provides flexible living space, including a spacious family room, office, additional room (currently configured as a fourth bedroom, with closets), and a full bathroom.    Pickleball courts, padel courts, playground, and Manresa Wilds are all less than one mile away. Village Creek also offers kayak storage and boat slips, available for an additional cost and subject to availability.
